entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Philip the Apostle Russian Orthodox Church is a Russian Orthodox Church located in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. It's part of the Patriarchate of Antioch. It is the only Christian Orthodox church in the Arabian Peninsula with an area of 1,800 square metres (19,000 sq ft) capacity of 20,000 worshippers. The church opened on Saturday August 13, 2011.
